spec.assertion: Trigger identity + reachability: the crafting loop needs 10 Scraps per magazine against a cap of 10, and the only Scrap source with a carrier in this fight is skill2-e1's battle-start ▲10. Proves magazines settle at 1. Fails under the nearest-wrong 'always at maximum 4' model (MAX_MAG_ATK counterfactual deals strictly more damage than BASE).

The consumption side is only observable through its effect on the magazine count, which the skill1 ATK-value assertion already pins (7.5% not 15/22.5/30%). No separate resource-pool event is asserted; a bare resource delta is unobservable in the event log.
Proves the cap is an upper BOUND, not the operating value: the ATK buff must be a positive multiple of 7.5 and strictly < 30. Fails under a model that hardcodes the maximum.

Scope (self only — no teammate receives a 7.5-multiple ATK buff), duration semantics (continuous — no wall-clock expiry inside the 180s fight), and non-zero contribution (stripping it lowers only E.H., teammates byte-identical). Fails under generic/ally scoping, under a 15s duration copied from skill2-e5, and under the line being dropped.

The single guaranteed Scrap grant; asserted through its downstream product — exactly one magazine's worth of ATK (7.5%). Fails if any additional Scrap source silently fires or if the grant is missing (0 magazines, no ATK buff at all).
it.skip — the sim has no destructible-projectile channel, so the trigger can never fire and the line is structurally unobservable.
it.skip — the scope-lock boss is PARTLESS (v1 has no parts; partsDamagePct is documented inert), so this Scrap source is unreachable.
it.skip — the solo-raid boss is never neutralized in a 180s fight; no neutralize channel exists.

Scope: the stat is ELEMENT-ADVANTAGE-scoped (elementDamagePct), not generic attackDamagePct. The fixture boss is Fire and E.H. is Wind, so she has no advantage and this line must pay ZERO. Fails under the nearest-wrong generic-Attack-Damage encoding, which would credit 16.36% on a boss she has no advantage against. Duration is a finite 15s window, not 'continuously'. Non-vacuity is asserted separately by confirming the fixture boss element is genuinely non-advantaged.

Weapon-state modifiers ARE damage: stripping the weaponSwap effect changes E.H.'s total and leaves every teammate byte-identical. Fails under a model that drops the swap as cosmetic/defensive and under an ally-scoped swap.

The swap magazine is 1 x magazines = 1 round at the reachable magazine count, and the kit's own deactivation clause ('when all rounds have been fired') therefore ends the window early rather than at 10s. Fails under the nearest-wrong maxAmmo=4, which quadruples swap shots and strictly increases damage.

The three magnitudes are literal kit values and are carried on the weaponSwap effect (chargeTimeSec / damagePct / chargeMultPct); the test asserts only the bounded shot economy of the window, since the per-shot decomposition is confounded by the co-active 430.05% ATK buff and the swap shot cadence is an ALWAYS-FLAG field (weapon-swap shot economy is kit-silent).

Dual deactivation condition — the window is bounded by 10s OR by the (1-round) magazine, whichever comes first. Covered by the ammo assertion above; a model with only the 10s bound and unbounded ammo is caught by the MAX_SWAP_AMMO divergence.

Four discriminators: (a) present — a >100 self ATK buff exists; (b) SELF-scoped — no teammate ever receives it (nearest-wrong: allies target, the largest possible over-credit in this kit); (c) trigger identity — application count never exceeds her OWN burst-cast count, failing under a fullBurstEnter keying that over-fires in multi-B3 comps; (d) duration — a finite expiry, not whole-fight.

fixtures: controlComp('e-h', true) only — one base run plus five withPatchedOverride counterfactuals (strip magazine ATK, magazine ATK at the 4-magazine maximum, strip burst ATK, strip weapon swap, swap maxAmmo=4), six runComp calls total, well under the ~20-run budget. The fixed-B3 helm slot is KEPT (flag true) because E.H. is a Burst III and a lone B3 casts nothing — B1+B2 are mandatory for any burst-slot assertion to be non-vacuous. The controlComp boss is Fire while E.H. is Wind, which is load-bearing rather than incidental: it is exactly the non-advantaged case that discriminates the element-scoped skill2-e5 buff from a generic Attack Damage encoding.
gaps: skill2 e2 'Scraps ▲1 when an ally or self destroys a destructible projectile' — it.skip: no destructible-projectile channel exists in the sim; the trigger can never fire.
skill2 e3 'Scraps ▲5 when an ally or self destroys an enemy's part' — it.skip: the scope-lock boss is partless (v1 models no parts), so the source is structurally unreachable.
skill2 e4 'Scraps ▲2 when an enemy is neutralized' — it.skip: the solo-raid boss is never neutralized within the 180s fight.
skill1 e1 'Removes Scrap(s)' — no direct assertion: a resource-pool delta emits no observable event; it is pinned only indirectly via the resulting magazine count (ATK = 7.5%, not a higher multiple).

burst per-shot decomposition (0.4s charge / 61% base / 250% full charge) — asserted structurally rather than numerically: the co-active 430.05% ATK buff confounds a per-hit magnitude read, and swap shot cadence is an ALWAYS-⚑ kit-silent field.
